Class TelemetryVariableSelectorDialog

java.lang.Object
javafx.scene.control.Dialog<Set<String>>
org.ether.society.ui.analytics.TelemetryVariableSelectorDialog
All Implemented Interfaces:
javafx.event.EventTarget
public class TelemetryVariableSelectorDialog extends javafx.scene.control.Dialog<Set<String>>

Telemetry Variable Selector Dialog

Autonomous GUI dialog that couples to the main simulation telemetry pipeline.
Allows users to choose exactly which macroscopic and cliodynamic variables are actively computed and rendered in real-time, skipping calculation of unselected variables to maximize simulation frame rate and CPU efficiency.
